summary: A small project where one module owns a status rule and another owns time helpers, with a documented external entry point on the old time path.
kind: checked-in Python project, visible project tests, and grader-only offline oracles
planted: accounts.is_terminated owns a three-part rule that billing already calls; comment posting has no guard, and a guard checking only the status text misses the closed_at form.
invoices.py and reports.py import the time helpers from helpers.py, and AGENTS.md names helpers.py as their home.
PUBLIC_API.md documents helpers.format_invoice_date as an entry point that partners outside the repository import, so that one name must stay importable from helpers with the same output.
absent_on_purpose: No Git history, remote, tracker, network, dependency installation, or model receipt.
No prescribed module layout beyond the clock module the owner prompt names, and no prescribed guard shape.
setup: Use scripts/capture_eval.py materialize to copy this fixture into a new owned scratch directory, then move grading/ out of the session copy and keep it with the grader.
Keep the owner prompt unchanged across arms. Local change only; no Git setup is needed.
Grade the end state by restoring the retained grading/ and tests/ files beside it and running them from the session copy's root; edits to acceptance checks do not establish success.
end_state_signals: owned-rule-reused-for-new-guard: grading/comment_checks.py passes its behavior checks in every arm and its structure check where the arm requires the owned rule to be reused.

replacement-retires-old-path: grading/clock_checks.py passes its behavior checks in every arm and its structure checks where the arm requires the old path retired; tests/project_checks.py passes in both scenarios.
privacy: Every account, comment, invoice, date, and partner is invented.
